name: Pressure Washer Nozzle
definition: A calibrated high-pressure outlet that converts pump flow into a defined jet or spray; orifice size, angle, pressure, flow, temperature, connection and surface task must be approved together.
includedScope: Orifice, pressure, temperature, connection and surface checks
excludedScope: Nozzle substitutions without pump and unloader validation
headline: Orifice size controls system load; spray angle controls surface intensity.
description: This profile maps fixed, multi-pattern and rotary pressure-washer nozzles using official ratings and practical pump, connector and surface gates.
metaDescription: Pressure washer nozzle sizes, spray angles, orifice ratings, quick-connect types, surface risks and compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, mechanical, electrical and fluid interfaces, rated operating envelope, protection requirements and approved service documentation.
